close_reason: Already documented: submission.rs:356-359 already explains why the pre-fetch must happen before the destroy loop.
description: handle_submission_set pre-fetches the emailId for all non-creation-reference submission IDs in onSuccess* args BEFORE running any create/update/destroy, then removes failed operations from the map after each loop. This means onSuccessUpdateEmail/onSuccessDestroyEmail works correctly for destroyed submissions (whose emailId would not be recoverable after destroy). A contributor might suggest moving the fetch inside each success handler to avoid an extra round trip when all operations fail — resist, because onSuccessDestroyEmail on a destroyed submission requires the emailId to have been fetched before destroy.
title: EmailSubmission/set pre-fetches submission→emailId map before destroy loop
